page-transition.reason: Native uses the platform's own stack navigator; only PageBack and the style helpers could carry over

toast.reason: ShopKartOS has no native toast yet; the web card ships first

input.reason: The native field (TextInput) follows once the web one is used by the apps

phone-top-bar.reason: Native has its own stack header; the bar mirrors ShopKartOS's phone header, a web shell piece

app-state.reason: Native has no such screens yet (ShopKartOS's app shows an ActivityIndicator); the block is web-only
